ItemID: NA; Title: International Superhits!       explicit_lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The punk energy fits my interest in Chuck, but I would choose heavier music today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Shot to Hell; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Heavy riffs and melodic vocals fit my interest in Alter Bridge and Disturbed.
ItemID: NA; Title: Adore; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its subdued, atmospheric sound is less suited to my current appetite for heavy guitars.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Best of Chicago; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Polished classic pop rock is outside the heavier sound I am seeking now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Sickness; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Ten Thousand Fists makes me interested in hearing more of Disturbed's aggressive riffs and vocals.
ItemID: NA; Title: United Abominations; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The thrash sound fits my interest in Advance And Vanquish, but other albums catch my attention first.
ItemID: NA; Title: Reign In Blood       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its speed and aggression appeal to the heavier side of my listening, especially In Flames and Dimmu Borgir.
ItemID: NA; Title: Vulgar Display of Power       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Forceful vocals and heavy grooves fit what I enjoy in Disturbed and heavier metal.
ItemID: NA; Title: Monster; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not tell me enough to connect it confidently with my taste.
ItemID: NA; Title: Above; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I cannot confidently identify this album from its title, so I would pass this time.
